messages:
Maria Chen: Quick check 1: added a compact Settings form mock. Two patterns: (A) compact inline errors under fields, (B) minimal inline markers + top error banner on submit. Also sketched a lightweight bulk-delete confirmation (snackbar undo vs typed-confirm). Thoughts on density and accessibility?

Devin Patel: Pattern A is clearer for single-field fixes. Pattern B feels cleaner for long forms but worry about banner visibility on mobile. Snackbar undo OK for soft deletes, typed-confirm for destructive org deletes.

Samir K.: For dense admin tables we should avoid large inline copy. Use short inline icons/labels + banner summary when >2 errors. Bulk deletes: prefer exact-name for org-level, snackbar undo for bulk soft deletes.

Rika Sato: Accessibility points: if using banner, ensure aria-live and move focus to it on failure. Inline errors need aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing to the message. Also prefer visible "Required" text over just an asterisk for critical fields.

DesignBot: Auto-scan: compact helper text contrast 3.7:1 (recommend >=4.5:1). Banner pattern missing focus transfer. Suggest adding aria-label="Form errors" to the banner.

Devin Patel: Actionable: 1) increase helper contrast or use slightly bolder text, 2) implement focus transfer to banner + focus first invalid control, 3) show explicit "Required" label in dense forms, 4) reserve typed-confirm for irreversible org deletes.

Maria Chen: Perfect. I'll update mocks with contrast and focus changes, and add copy options for exact-name/typed-confirm. Tagging @Samir to review exact-name wording. Thanks! :+1:

Samir K.: Happy to take copy. Suggest: "Type the organization name to confirm deletion: example-org"
